h1: Custom Etched Awards for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom etched awards for your next recognition event. Shop bulk etched awards at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Etched awards offer a sophisticated, permanent way to recognize achievements. Unlike printed or engraved options, etching cuts into the material itself, creating a crisp, lasting impression on glass, crystal, or acrylic. Whether you need executive gifts like the Awards in Motion® Afton or team recognition with the Wave Award, etching ensures your logo and text stand out with precision. Ideal for annual galas or safety milestones, these awards convey quality and permanence.
heroAltText: Custom etched awards including crystal obelisks and glass bowls with precise etched logos and text
